eval: localStorage.setItem('catchTheWolf.save', JSON.stringify({version:1,pelts:3,streak:0,bestStreak:12,seenHowTo:true,shopPromptShown:true,farm:[{uid:1,breed:'white',name:'A',x:0.5,y:0.5},{uid:2,breed:'lamb',name:'B',x:0.4,y:0.5}],settings:{sound:false,hungryWolf:true}})); location.hash='title'; location.reload(); 1

(()=>{const d=ctw.save.data; return {test:'v1 save migrates: farm counts as bought, hungry toggle gone', v:d.version, bought:d.stats.bought, ok: d.version===2 && d.stats.bought.join()==='white,lamb' && !('hungryWolf' in d.settings) && d.runSeed>0}})()

(()=>{const d=ctw.save.data; return {test:'old best streak earns its achievement on the title screen', got:Object.keys(d.achievements), toast:!!document.querySelector('.achv-toast'), ok: !!d.achievements['streak-10'] && !d.achievements['streak-25']}})()

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const per=R.roundsPerDay(); let bad=0, slots={}; for(let seed=1;seed<300;seed++) for(let day=0;day<12;day++){ const hits=[]; for(let i=0;i<per;i++) if(R.isHungryRound(day*per+i, seed)) hits.push(i); if(hits.length!==1) bad++; else { const id=R.calendarFor(day*per+hits[0]).time.id; slots[id]=(slots[id]||0)+1; } } return {test:'hungry wolf: exactly one round a day, never dawn or midnight', bad, slots, ok: bad===0 && !slots.dawn && !slots.midnight && Object.keys(slots).length===4}})()

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const rpt=R.roundsPerTime(); let split=0, changes=0; for(let seed=1;seed<40;seed++) for(let b=0;b<60;b++){ const w=[...Array(rpt).keys()].map(i=>R.makeRound(b*rpt+i,{runSeed:seed}).weather); if(new Set(w).size>1) split++; } const times=[...Array(R.roundsPerDay()).keys()].map(i=>R.calendarFor(i).time.id); return {test:'each time of day lasts several rounds with steady weather', rpt, times:times.join(','), split, ok: rpt>=2 && split===0 && times[0]===times[rpt-1] && times[rpt]!==times[0]}})()

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const d=ctw.save.data; d.runSeed=77; let hs=-1, cs=-1; for(let i=0;i<R.roundsPerDay();i++){ if(R.isHungryRound(i,77)) hs=i; else if(i>0) cs=i; } d.streak=hs; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); const a=!!ctw.scene.hunger; const label=document.querySelector('[data-tier]').textContent; d.streak=cs; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); const b=!!ctw.scene.hunger; d.streak=hs; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); return {test:'play: hungry only on its slot, shown in the HUD', hs, cs, label, ok: a && !b && /Hungry/.test(label)}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const d=ctw.save.data; const kind=s.round.tell.kind; const before=d.stats.tellsFound[kind]||0; const w=s.sheep.find(x=>x.isWolf); s.pointer({type:'down',x:w.x,y:w.y,id:1}); return {test:'catch counts the tell kind and lightning', kind, n:d.stats.tellsFound[kind], lightning:d.stats.lightning, ok: d.stats.tellsFound[kind]===before+1 && d.stats.lightning===1}})()

(async()=>{const A=await import('./js/game/achievements.js'); const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const d=ctw.save.data; A.noteStampede(d, 21); const top=A.topBreed().id; d.farm=[]; for(let i=0;i<12;i++) d.farm.push({uid:100+i,breed:top,name:'T'+i,x:.5,y:.5}); d.stats.bought=R.db.breeds.filter(b=>b.price!=null).map(b=>b.id); d.stats.tellsFound.eyes=25; const got=A.checkAchievements(d).map(a=>a.id).sort(); const all=A.allAchievements(); return {test:'stampede, collector, prize flock and tell goals unlock', got, total:all.length, ids:new Set(all.map(a=>a.id)).size===all.length, ok: ['collector-all','prize-12','stampede-10','stampede-20','tell-eyes-10','tell-eyes-25'].every(x=>got.includes(x)) && !got.includes('stampede-30') && !got.includes('prize-24') && all.length===51}})()

(async()=>{const M=await import('./js/scenes/achievements.js'); ctw.go('title'); M.openAchievements(ctw); const rows=document.querySelectorAll('.achv-list li').length, done=document.querySelectorAll('.achv-list li.done').length; return {test:'achievements dialog lists everything', rows, done, ok: rows===51 && done>=7}})()

(()=>{document.querySelector('.scrim [data-close]').click(); const d=ctw.save.data; d.farm=[]; const breeds=['white','lamb','brown','grey','black','lamb','white','rose','lamb','ram','lopear','white']; breeds.forEach((b,i)=>d.farm.push({uid:200+i,breed:b,name:'F'+i,x:0.15+(i%4)*0.22,y:0.2+Math.floor(i/4)*0.25})); d.toys=[{uid:300,item:'ball',x:0.5,y:0.8}]; d.foods=[]; d.pantry={}; ctw.save.write(); window._realNow=Date.now; ctw.go('farm'); return 'farm'})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const kinds=s.world.spots.map(x=>x.kind).sort(); const sh=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isLamb); const pond=s.world.spots.find(x=>x.kind==='pond'); sh.seek(pond); window._drinker=sh; return {test:'farm fixtures exist', kinds, bed:!!s.world.bed, ok: kinds.join()==='hay,pond,trough'}})()

(()=>{const sh=_drinker; const s=ctw.scene; const pond=s.world.spots.find(x=>x.kind==='pond'); const d=Math.hypot(sh.x-pond.x,sh.y-pond.y); return {test:'a sheep walks to the pond and drinks', state:sh.state, dist:+(d/pond.r).toFixed(2), ok: (sh.state==='eat' && sh.food===pond) || (sh.state!=='seek' && d < pond.r*2.2)}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const lamb=s.sheep.find(x=>x.isLamb); const adult=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isLamb && x!==_drinker); const w={...s.world, night:true}; let chase=0, bed=0; for(let i=0;i<300;i++){ s.toys.forEach(t=>t.chaser=null); lamb.state='idle'; lamb.choose(w); if(lamb.state==='chase') chase++; if(lamb.toy){lamb.toy.chaser=null; lamb.toy=null;} adult.choose(w); if(adult.bedtime||adult.state==='lie') bed++; adult.bedtime=false; adult.leaveFood(); if(adult.toy){adult.toy.chaser=null; adult.toy=null;} } for(const x of [lamb,adult]){x.state='idle'; x.stateT=1;} return {test:'night: lambs play ball, grown-ups go to bed', lambChase:chase/300, adultBed:bed/300, ok: chase/300>0.45 && bed/300>0.6}})()

(()=>{const base=Math.floor(_realNow()/240000)*240000 + 0.76*240000; const t0=_realNow(); Date.now=()=>base+(_realNow()-t0)*0.0; const s=ctw.scene; const adults=s.sheep.filter(x=>!x.isLamb); const nn=(list)=>list.reduce((m,a)=>m+Math.min(...list.filter(b=>b!==a).map(b=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y))),0)/list.length; window._nn0=nn(adults); return {nightSet:true, nn0:Math.round(_nn0)}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const adults=s.sheep.filter(x=>!x.isLamb); const sl=adults.filter(x=>x.asleep); const huddled=sl.filter(a=>sl.some(b=>b!==a && Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<150*a.scale)).length; return {test:'night: the flock huddles up to sleep', night:s.world.night, asleep:sl.length, huddled, of:adults.length, ok: s.world.night && sl.length>=adults.length*0.6 && huddled>=adults.length*0.5}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const A=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isLamb && x.asleep) || s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isLamb); A.state='sleep'; A.stateT=30; A.pose.lie=1; const B=s.sheep.find(x=>x!==A && !x.asleep && x.state!=='angry') || s.sheep.find(x=>x!==A); B.state='idle'; B.stateT=5; const t=s.toys[0]; t.kicker=B; t.x=A.x+60*A.scale; t.y=A.y; t.vx=-400*s.sc; t.vy=0; window._A=A; window._B=B; window._a0=[A.x,A.y]; return 'ball rolling at a sleeper'})()

(()=>{return {test:'a ball wakes a sleeper: it gets angry at the kicker, who runs', a:_A.state, b:_B.state, target:_A.angryAt===_B, banner:document.querySelector('.banner')?.textContent, ok: _A.state==='angry' && _A.angryAt===_B && _B.state==='flee'}})()

(()=>({test:'the angry sheep gives chase', a:_A.state, charged:Math.round(Math.hypot(_A.x-_a0[0],_A.y-_a0[1])), rams:_A.rams||0, ok: _A.state==='angry' && (Math.hypot(_A.x-_a0[0],_A.y-_a0[1])>40 || _A.rams>0)}))()
(()=>({test:'after ten seconds the grudge is over', a:_A.state, b:_B.state, ok: _A.state!=='angry' && _B.state!=='flee'}))()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const A=_A; A.state='sleep'; A.stateT=30; A.pose.lie=1; const t=s.toys[0]; t.kicker=null; t.x=A.x+60*A.scale; t.y=A.y; t.vx=-400*s.sc; t.vy=0; return 'thrown by the player'})()

(()=>{const t=ctw.scene.toys[0]; const mad=ctw.scene.sheep.filter(x=>x.state==='angry'); return {test:'woken by your throw: it takes it out on the ball', angry:mad.length, atToy:mad.every(x=>x.angryAt===t), ok: mad.length>0 && mad.every(x=>x.angryAt===t)}})()
(()=>{Date.now=_realNow; return 'clock restored'})()
